questions.question: Do you repair laptops in Bhaktapur?
questions.answer: Yes. We repair Windows laptops: screen, battery, keyboard, RAM and software problems. Bring it to our shop in Sukuldhoka, Bhaktapur, or message us on WhatsApp for pickup and drop inside Bhaktapur.

questions.question: Can you tell me the repair price on WhatsApp?
questions.answer: No. We check the laptop in person first, then give you the price. A price given without seeing the laptop is usually wrong, so we don't guess.

questions.question: Do you pick up the laptop from my home?
questions.answer: Yes, anywhere inside Bhaktapur. We collect the laptop, repair it, and bring it back to you. Send your area and the problem to 984-0270440 on WhatsApp.

questions.question: Do you repair MacBooks or tablets?
questions.answer: No. We repair Windows laptops only, not MacBooks, iPads or other tablets.

questions.question: Do you repair printers?
questions.answer: Yes, small printer problems. Send the printer model and what's wrong to 984-0270440 on WhatsApp, and we'll tell you whether we can fix it.

questions.question: What else do you repair?
questions.answer: Speakers, amplifiers, fans, heaters, induction and infrared cookers, mixers and grinders are repaired at our shop in Sukuldhoka, Bhaktapur. Bring the item to the shop.

questions.question: What are your opening hours?
questions.answer: Sunday to Friday, 9am to 7pm. Closed on Saturday.

questions.question: Which areas do you cover?
questions.answer: Bhaktapur only. Laptop pickup and drop runs inside Bhaktapur. Anyone can bring an item to the shop in Sukuldhoka.

questions.question: Where is your shop?
questions.answer: In Sukuldhoka, Bhaktapur. We're open Sunday to Friday, 9am to 7pm, and closed on Saturday. Message 984-0270440 on WhatsApp and we'll send you the Google Maps location.
